items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tubby had the general store and they used to show movies on Mondays in the summer, and we used to dance to the juke box in his store.

ctx.x: the mix? What was the feeling of the community?

Well, the people, the majority of the people there had African and Indian and European ancestors and they were olive-skinned people and they didn't want anything to change. They didn't want you if you had too much African blood. You know what I mean? You just didn't belong. And there was one school and two churches and two grocery stores and the lake, Kaufman's Lake.
